output.summary: Herbaceous perennial native to much of Europe, northwest Africa and southwest Asia, usually growing in moist places. It spreads through underground stems, smells distinctly minty throughout, and bears dense rounded clusters of tiny purple flowers. It is used as an edible herb and to make herbal tea.
output.edibilityNote: Used as an edible herb, like spearmint or peppermint, and to make herbal tea.
